## 改了什麼／What changed


## 怎麼測的／How it was tested


## 檢查清單／Checklist

- [ ] `python dramakit/check_public.py --range origin/main..HEAD` 沒有找到東西／finds nothing
- [ ] 沒有 `projects/` 的檔案、影音圖檔、任務檔、憑證／no files from `projects/`, no media, job files or credentials
- [ ] 範例、文件、註解、commit 訊息裡沒有我的劇名、角色、台詞、頻道或影片 ID／no series title, character, line, channel or video id of mine in examples, docs, comments or commit messages
- [ ] 沒有 API key、email、電話、家目錄路徑、真人照片或聲音／no API key, e-mail, phone number, home-folder path, or real person's photo or voice
- [ ] 截圖已去識別化、去掉 EXIF／screenshots de-identified, EXIF stripped
- [ ] 文件先改 `docs/zh-TW/` 再同步 `docs/en/`（有改文件的話）／docs: zh-TW first, then en (if docs changed)
